title: Mom's Slipper Dweller
description: As shown in the picture it adds a pink slipper owned by mom and the slipper can attack, jump 5 blocks, and run at you and deal half your HP in 1 hit.
body:
# The **Mom's Slipper Dweller**
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1275914987591700501?label=join%20our%20discord&logo=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/asFz88Ghj3)


This mod adds the Moms slipper dweller to your world! He does a lot of damage and is very fast, so run quickly!

# 🩴 How it Spawns

Spawns randomly at a random place at a random time! Can also be spawned by spawn egg in creative mode.

# 💻 Alpha

This mod is currently in alpha and will be continuously updated with more slippers possibly variants.
